description: Awarding the Contract for the construction of the proposed seven storied residential building for the Sri Lanka Railways under the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure to award the contract for the construction of the proposed seven storied residential building for the Sri Lanka Railways under the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal Development Project. Five bids have been received for the same and four bids have been determined to be technically responsive. After the evaluation pertaining to the relevant financial bids, the Standing High Level Procurement Committee has recommended to award the relevant contract to Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd for a sum of Rs. 1.53 billion (excluding VAT). Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the said contract, was approved by the Cabinet.
